defs.def: all the words that a person knows or uses （某人掌握或使用的）词汇，词汇量

ex.s: They had a very limited vocabulary.
ex.t: 他们的词汇量非常有限。

ex.s: It’s not all that hard to build an advanced and large vocabulary.
ex.t: 要构建一个高级而庞大的词汇量并不那么难。

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为十几岁时几____58____（month 个月）的锻炼就足以____59____（受益）余生，建立词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己拥有出色的词汇量。

ex.s: One of the    60   (effect) ways to build vocabulary is to read good books.
ex.t: 建立词汇量最有效（60）的方法之一就是读好书。

ex.s: This isn’t as hard as it    62   (sound), and it is far better than any other method because you improve your vocabulary while    63   (read) an interesting piece of literature.
ex.t: 这并不像它___62___（听起来）那么难，而且远比任何其他方法好，因为你在___63___（阅读）一篇有趣的文学作品时提高了词汇量。

ex.s: It is different from British English in several ways, mostly in spelling and vocabulary.
ex.t: 它在几个方面与英式英语不同，主要在拼写和词汇上。

ex.s: What new vocabulary and structures did you learn in this unit?
ex.t: 你在本单元学到了哪些新词汇和句型结构？

ex.s: I can’t keep all the new vocabulary straight in my head, and I certainly can’t remember how to use them all properly.
ex.t: 我脑子里记不住所有的新词汇，当然也更记不清该如何正确地使用它们。

ex.s: Between 1972 and 1986, four more volumes were added with new technical and scientific vocabulary and words from other English-speaking countries, such as Canada, the USA, Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa.
ex.t: 1972至1986年间，又增补了四卷，收入了新的科技词汇以及来自加拿大、美国、澳大利亚、新西兰和南非等其他英语国家的词语。

defs.def: all the words in a particular language （某一语言的）词汇，词汇量

ex.s: Do you with remembering vocabulary or lose heart over the writing ?
ex.t: 你是在记单词方面（有困难），还是对写作感到灰心丧气？

a list of words with their meanings, especially in a book for learning a foreign language （尤指外语教科书中附有释义的）词汇表
